data.gender_notes: Ghaaliya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'ghalila' which means 'to call'. In Islamic tradition, it signifies the one who calls to Allah, or the one who is called by Allah. The name Ghaaliya carries the meaning “One who calls [to Allah]” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaaliya usually hope their child will grow to embody one who calls [to allah] and live with faith, good character and purpose.
